proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the frame logo/decal and any serial number.
Close-up photos of brakes, gear cluster/derailleur, and chain.
A short video showing the bike being pedaled with gears shifting and brakes applied.
Close-up of tire tread/sidewalls and the discolored area near the front fork.
Clarification/proof (receipt, date-stamped photo) resolving the contradiction between '3 years unused' and 'bought new 6 months ago'.
response.reason: The seller's own account of the bike's history is self-contradictory (unused for 3 years vs. bought new 6 months ago), and the single distant photo cannot confirm claimed 'perfect' brakes/gears or rule out rust, so even a worst-case price needs the missing close-ups and a resolved history before it can be set.
